@description:
 [Vocational] A sailor rarely travels inland; preferring to feel the spray of
 the ocean on his face. He is perfectly at home on the water (though he might
 spend a bit of time in the taverns on the docks). Time to Acquire: 28 months.
 Starting Money: normal.
